name: free-gst-billing-software
description: Free, open-source GST invoice & billing software for India. Tax Invoice, Proforma, Credit Note, Bill of Supply, Delivery Challan, GSTR-1 / GSTR-3B JSON exports, GSTR-2B reconciliation, e-Way Bill, TDS / TCS reports (Form 26Q / 27EQ), multi-currency for 22 countries, per-line custom units, rich-text Terms with 13 India presets, granular backup with optional Google Drive sync. Offline-first PWA.
